import copy,json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
assert actual==report,(actual,report)
assert set(report[0])=={'ok','records','errors'}
assert set(report[0]['records'][0])=={'id','amount'}
print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))

import copy,json
from work import evaluate
probes=[
({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':2},'unique':True}),
({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':True,'unit':[]},{'id':'x','amount':1,'unit':[]},{'id':'x','amount':1},{'id':'x','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True}),
({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'z','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'q','amount':-0.0}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':3},'unique':False})]
for request,policy in probes:
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy)
 result=evaluate(request,policy)
 assert request==rb and policy==pb
 print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
